$comment: Live release announcements for Desktop, self-hosted and Cloud. New updaters poll this document on main independently of immutable release binaries; announcement-only edits use the lightweight Release advisories validator. Published release tags remain unchanged and provide a fallback. Older updaters still read the tagged copy and need a one-time application update to use the live document. Omit modes to include all installations. Severity controls prominence; announce controls interruptions. An update notice must exclude the latest published version from its affected range. Signed runtime-security advisories remain in security-advisories.json.

advisories.title: Update to Openship 0.9.5
advisories.message: Openship 0.9.5 fixes the Compose dashboard readiness failure that blocked edge startup after 0.9.4, and explains source-redeploy prerequisites before runtime security refreshes.
